{{Quote|Anyone unlucky enough to cross Rogun the Butcher should measure his or her future lifespan in days; this gangster comes by his nickname honestly, having left a trail of bodies from one end of the galaxy to the other&mdash;with no end in sight.|[[Viidu]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Rogun Matt'rik''', better known as '''Rogun the Butcher''', was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] who was one of the top [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]] in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] underworld during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I'm man enough to admit you saved my life. Guess that's worth a ship full of blasters.|Rogun|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />}}
Rogun inherited his criminal empire after his mentor [[Ivory]] was imprisoned on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. Three of his most notable traits was that he always owned a piece of the action, never backed down from a fight, and had a zero tolerance policy for failure.

In [[3643 BBY]], he got involved in the feud between [[Skavak/Legends|Skavak]] and the [[Voidhound]] when Skavak stole a ship full of weapons meant for Rogun. Though the Voidhound insisted that Skavak was to blame, Rogun refused to accept excuses and repeatedly dispatched [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] after the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], none of which were successful.

[[3642 BBY|A year later]], Rogun's men tracked down the Voidhound at [[Port Nowhere]]. Communicating via hologram, Rogun had a first direct conversation with the smuggler and announced his bounty on his head, compelling every two-bit thug in hearing range to try and claim it. The Voidhound not only survived the skirmish, but also freed Rogun's captives, [[Darmas Pollaran]] and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bevera Dodonna]], unaware that the two were plotting against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Pollaran, an agent of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]], told the Voidhound that Rogun was the right hand of the [[Harridax Kirill|Voidwolf]], and that they had to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Rogun and take over his criminal empire to get to the man.

[[File:Rogun_Mattrik.jpg|left|thumb|On Tatooine, Rogun was forced to let the past go and join forces with the smuggler who pestered him for over two years.]]
Rogun sent [[Languss Tuno]] to [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] with a mission to kill the smuggler. However, Tuno suffered abuse at the hands of [[Shai Tenna]] and decided that more was to be gained by defecting from Rogun and joining the Voidhound's crew. Unaware that Rogun supported the Republic and deciding to take the mission more seriously after saving Dodonna from another of Rogun's bounty hunters, the Voidhound tracked down Ivory on Belsavis and saved him from Rogun's best hunter, [[Dust (Abyssin)|Dust]]. The smuggler got from Ivory the information on Rogun's safe houses and afterwards disrupted Rogun's [[Ssorokk|cyberbeast]] smuggling ring on [[Voss]]. In response, Rogun summoned all his surviving lieutenants to his safe house on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

When confronted by Voidhound, Rogun accused the smuggler of being a traitor to the Republic, to the smuggler's confusion. Suddenly, two [[Sith (species)/Legends|Pureblood Sith]], [[Chane]] and [[Desora]], interrupted their meeting, displaying a hologram of the Voidwolf, who mocked Voidhound's naivety. The [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] revealed that Pollaran and Dodonna were working for the Voidwolf, and in reality, Rogun rooted for the Republic, and he was the only man standing in the way of the Voidwolf from unifying the galactic underworld for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

{{GameLS}}
Ignoring the past differences, the Voidhound and Rogun joined in their efforts in surviving and killed both of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. As a reward for saving his life, Rogun agreed to forget their previous dispute. The Voidhound made a deal with Rogun to take out the Voidwolf, and the two then decided to continually work together, with Rogun sending the Voidhound to meet [[Curao]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Rogun appears in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as one of the main antagonists of the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] storyline, though he and player join efforts in the end. In the dark-side option, the player has the option to kill him on Tatooine. Alternatively, if Voidhound creates their own criminal empire, Rogun becomes one of their associates.
